# KeePass KDBX fixtures — attribution

These `.kdbx` / `.keyx` files are the public test fixtures from
[`sseemayer/keepass-rs`](https://github.com/sseemayer/keepass-rs)
(`tests/resources/`), MIT licensed. They are generated by KeePassXC and are
used here only to prove that PhantomVault's A13 importer opens real KDBX 4
containers (Argon2/AES-256 and Argon2id/ChaCha20, plus password + key file).

Passwords used by the upstream tests:

- `test_db_kdbx4_with_password_argon2.kdbx` — `demopass`
- `test_db_kdbx4_with_password_argon2id_chacha20.kdbx` — `demopass`
- `test_db_kdbx4_with_keyfile_v2.kdbx` + `.keyx` — `demopass` + the key file

Do not add private vaults here.
